notes: An assistant, in a column beside the page. Off until you turn it on in Settings › AI: ⌘⇧A opens a conversation that sits next to the page rather than over it, so the page stays readable while the answer comes in. Ask about the page, add another tab, a file or a picture to the question, and the answer comes with a rail of what it read and what it did. Given the second switch it acts — clicks, types, scrolls, opens pages in tabs behind the one you are reading — and anything that spends money, deletes, sends what can't be recalled or grants access asks first, in a card that names the control and the site. It answers from Ollama or LM Studio on this Mac, from your own key at Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini or OpenRouter, or from an API of your own; the conversations are kept on this Mac, in a page of their own, unless you turn that off. The interface answers your hand: every button gives under the press and springs back, Settings is ten short sections with a colour to a group and a field that finds any setting by its words, a tab says what it is when the pointer rests on it, the space's dot opens a card of every space, and a page's right-click menu is a page's own — Save Page As…, Export as PDF…, Print…, Share…, Translate Page, Hide This Element. A tab put to sleep is kept in memory rather than let go: going back to it takes 23 ms on x.com, 41 on YouTube, 71 on GitHub, where loading it again took a second and a half. Also: ⌘W on a tab a link opened goes back to the page that opened it, an update no longer costs every site its service worker when no extension is installed, and a muted tab comes back muted.
notesZh: 一个在页面旁边的助手。这一版把附加功能打开，设置 › AI 里打开才生效：⌘⇧A 在页面旁边开一段对话，不是压在页面上，页面照旧能读，答案从旁边来。你可以问这一页，把另一个标签页、一个文件或一张照片加进问题；答案下面有一条栏，写着它读了什么、做了什么。再打开一个开关，它就动手：点击、输入、滚动、在你读的这一页身后开新标签页；花钱、删除、发出去收不回来、给出权限这四件事，它先问一句，卡片上写着是哪个控件、哪个网站。答案来自本机的 Ollama 或 LM Studio，来自你自己在 Anthropic、OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter 的密钥，或来自你自己的一个接口；对话存在这台 Mac 上，有自己的一页，也可以关掉。界面开始回手：每个按钮按下去会陷、松开弹回；设置是十个短分区，一组一个颜色，一个输入框按你说的话就能找到任何一项；指针停在标签页上，它会说出自己是什么；空间的那个点开出一张列着全部空间的卡片；网页右键是页面自己的菜单——存储为、导出 PDF、打印、共享、翻译页面、隐藏这个元素。睡着的标签页不再被放掉，而是冻在内存里：回到 x.com 上是 23 毫秒，YouTube 41，GitHub 71，而重新加载要一秒半。另外：⌘W 关掉一个从链接打开的页面，会回到开它的那一页；更新不再让每个网站丢掉自己的 service worker；静音的标签页回来还是静音的。
